name: Donyal Tovald
summary: In Stormwind Keep, Donyal Tovald tends the Royal Library’s historical works. Young King Anduin Wrynn sponsors his work to preserve and copy books for wider public use.

sections.title: Steward of Stormwind's History
sections.body: Donyal Tovald tends the Royal Library in Stormwind Keep. Its historical accounts, scrolls, and scholarly volumes chiefly serve the nobility and royal court. Young King Anduin Wrynn has sponsored an effort to share that knowledge with ordinary citizens. So Tovald preserves and copies the texts, keeping the Alliance’s lessons and triumphs recorded amid the kingdom’s political troubles.

faq.answer: Donyal Tovald tends the Royal Library in Stormwind Keep. He cares for the kingdom’s archives and oversees King Anduin Wrynn’s effort to share copies of historical books with the public.

faq.q: Where can I find Donyal Tovald?
faq.answer: You can find Donyal Tovald in the Royal Library wing on the eastern side of Stormwind Keep, among bookshelves and historical scrolls.

faq.q: Why is he handing out books to citizens?
faq.answer: Young King Anduin Wrynn sponsored a royal project to share knowledge with the public. Donyal Tovald oversees the copying and distribution of royal manuscripts.

faq.q: Is he affiliated with the House of Nobles or the clergy?
faq.answer: Tovald works directly under the crown as keeper of royal archives in Stormwind Keep. He focuses on historical and scholarly texts rather than ecclesiastical or political doctrine.

angles.text: As a human of Stormwind, you see Tovald’s work as part of preserving and rebuilding your culture and recorded history after the First War and the capital’s reconstruction.
As a mage visiting Stormwind Keep, you may value Tovald’s care for written knowledge. These texts are mainly historical rather than arcane.
